projects.title: Reasoning-Focused SLM Fine-Tuning
projects.description:
This project focuses on fine-tuning a Small Language Model (SLM) for structured reasoning to perform Root Cause Analysis (RCA) on 5G/LTE drive-test telelogs.

The goal is not just to predict the correct root cause, but to reason like a telecom RF engineer — step by step, using evidence from user-plane KPIs, mobility behavior, and engineering parameters.
